subject: POC: success criteria, trial plan & final readout scheduling — Aurora Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@aurorahealth.org>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@aurorahealth.org>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + POC next steps (success criteria + timeline)

Hi Emily / Rajiv —

Thanks again for your time today — great discussion and excited about the potential to reduce time-to-insight for your clinical analytics team. Per our call, I wanted to confirm the proposed success criteria and next steps so we can lock the POC scope.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm or edit):
- Accuracy: model matches or exceeds 85% on Aurora-labeled holdout for clinical note extraction
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 250ms for 512-token requests in your env
- Cost: per-token spend stays within the $0.003 target during the trial workload
- Integration: API integration + end-to-end test cases executed by Aurora engineering

Proposed evaluation plan / timeline:
1) Week 0 (this week): finalize SOW, provide test dataset + secure data transfer
2) Weeks 1-3: POC execution (integration, prompt tuning, run evaluation harness)
3) Week 4: Final readout with execs — scorecard review and decision (go / no-go)

Owners (Redwood): me (sales) + Marcus Lin (solutions engineer). Owners (Aurora): Rajiv (eng lead) + Dr. Kavita (clinical lead).

Attachments I’ll send: draft SOW + Redwood evaluation template. If that looks good, can we lock the final-readout week of Apr 26-30?

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: POC_SOW_Aurora_20270411.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]
[Attachment: Redwood_Eval_Template.xlsx (XLSX, 60KB)]

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@aurorahealth.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@aurorahealth.org>, Dr. Kavita Patel <kavita.patel@aurorahealth.org>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + POC next steps (success criteria + timeline)

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and aligns with our internal thinking. A few clarifications from our side:

- Success criteria: we agree to the 85% accuracy target and latency target, but will also validate on a clinical-entity recall metric (we'll share the rubric).
- Timeline: 3-week POC works for us; target final readout the week of Apr 26.
- Evaluation ownership: Rajiv will own technical validation; Kavita will lead clinical scoring.

I’ve attached our evaluation rubric and a small sample dataset (anonymized) for initial tuning. Please confirm secure upload location for the full dataset.

We can tentatively schedule the final readout for Tue, Apr 27 at 11:00 PT — pending calendar invites and availability of our execs (Sophie Lane, CFO; and our CTO).

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Chen | Sr. Product Manager, Clinical Analytics
Aurora Health
[Attachment: Aurora_Eval_Rubric.xlsx (XLSX, 32KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@aurorahealth.org>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + POC next steps (success criteria + timeline)

Appreciate the quick response, Emily — great. Confirming the secure upload: we’ll create a pre-signed S3 transfer link and send via our secure file transfer (I’ll loop in engineering).

Immediate next steps from Redwood:
- I’ll upload the signed SOW and our evaluation template to the shared Drive (attached here)
- Marcus will reach out to Rajiv to schedule a technical kickoff and get test dataset details
- We’ll provision a dedicated POC endpoint (isolated) and provide API keys for Aurora’s test environment

Please review the attached SOW and the eval template; if everything looks good we’ll consider the POC start date to be Mon, Apr 12.

Best,
Marissa
[Attachment: POC_SOW_Aurora_20270411.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]
[Attachment: Redwood_Eval_Template.xlsx (XLSX, 60KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@aurorahealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: POC technical kickoff & dataset checklist

Hi Rajiv —

Following up to kick off the technical side. Quick checklist so we can hit Week 1 objectives:
- Secure transfer: please upload the anonymized evaluation dataset to the S3 link Marissa will share
- Test cases: provide 5 representative production queries + expected outputs (format: JSONL)
- Access: add the following engineers to a shared Slack channel for quick triage (list them when ready)
- Monitoring: we will enable realtime telemetry and provide a Grafana link to share latency and error rates

Tech timeline: provision endpoint (24-48h) -> integration & smoke tests (days 2-5) -> run eval harness (week 2) -> tuning & re-runs (week 3).

I’ve scheduled a 30-min kickoff for Tue Apr 13 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@aurorahealth.org>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@aurorahealth.org>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@aurorahealth.org>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Exec readout & procurement next steps

Hi Sophie / Emily — looping in on the upcoming final readout. A couple of items to confirm so the exec review is productive:

1) Decision process: will the execs make a go/no-go decision during the readout, or is the readout an input to a later procurement approval? We want to make sure our commercial team times the term-sheet and procurement conversations correctly.
2) Contract timeline: If the readout is a go, what is Aurora’s standard procurement timeline (SOW signature, PO, expected legal review window)?
3) Pre-reads: we’ll prepare a concise 1-2 page scorecard and a short demo recording; please confirm any additional materials you’d like pre-shared 48 hours prior.

I’ve attached a draft term sheet for your review — we can iterate quickly if there are specific purchase order or security/legal constraints.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Draft_Term_Sheet_Aurora.pdf (PDF, 22KB)]

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@aurorahealth.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@aurorahealth.org>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@aurorahealth.org>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec readout & procurement next steps

Thanks Rishi — confirmed. Final readout: Tue Apr 27 at 11:00 PT; invite sent to Sophie, CTO, Rajiv, Kavita, and a couple of our product folks. The readout will be the decision point for execs (we expect a go/no-go).

Procurement notes: typical timing is 2-3 weeks after exec approval for SOW signature + PO issuance — our Legal will review but they are familiar with standard vendor templates.

Pre-reads requested: 1) 1-page scorecard with numeric scores and pass/fail flags, 2) short demo recording, 3) links to evaluation harness outputs (CSV). Please share those by Fri Apr 23 EOD so execs have time to review.

HubSpot / Drive links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/aurora-health (HubSpot) and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cC-poc-aurora-readout (Drive).

Looking forward —
Emily

Aurora Health
